title: A deleted category's lines report under Uncategorized
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $135.00, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A.
  3. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  4. Click Delete.
  5. Click Delete in the question.
  6. Open Reports › Sales by Category.
  7. Pick customer B in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories page lists category A.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The menu shows Audit Log and Delete.

Step 4:

  • The Delete question opens.

Step 5:

  • Category A is deleted.

Step 6:

  • Sales by Category opens.

Step 7:

  • Uncategorized reads $135.00.
  • Category A has no row.
